title: Ask for a missing receipt
es: Me falta el recibo de esta compra. ¿Me lo puede enviar?
en: I am missing the receipt for this purchase. Could you send it to me?
goals: Identify the exact missing record.
Confirm the date and amount.
Agree how and when it will be sent.

title: Explain a cash-flow difference
es: La factura está registrada como ingreso, pero todavía no hemos recibido el pago.
en: The invoice is recorded as revenue, but we have not received the payment yet.
goals: Distinguish revenue recorded from cash received.
Ask when the customer expects to pay.
Summarize the effect on the example cash forecast.

title: Correct an unsupported entry
es: Ese gasto no aparece en los documentos que recibí. Necesito comprobarlo antes de cambiar el informe.
en: That expense does not appear in the documents I received. I need to verify it before changing the report.
goals: Explain what is missing without accusing the client.
Ask for supporting records.
Confirm the documented next step and who owns it.

title: Check available money
es: ¿Cuál es mi saldo disponible? ¿Este pago todavía está pendiente?
en: What is my available balance? Is this payment still pending?
goals: Ask about the available balance.
Identify the pending transaction.
Repeat the amount and currency back.

title: Ask about an investment fund
es: ¿Qué comisiones cobra este fondo? ¿Puedo perder parte del dinero invertido?
en: What fees does this fund charge? Could I lose some of the money I invest?
goals: Ask what the fund holds.
Ask about fees, access to money and possible losses.
Explain the questions in your own words.

title: Question a duplicate settled charge
es: Veo 2 cargos por la misma compra y los 2 están completados. Tengo el recibo de un solo pago.
en: I see 2 charges for the same purchase, and both have settled. I have the receipt for only one payment.
goals: Identify the transactions and their status.
Distinguish a hold from a settled charge.
Ask what evidence and follow-up the bank requires.

title: Ask for a better price
es: ¿Cuánto cuesta? Si compro 2, ¿me puede hacer un mejor precio?
en: How much does it cost? If I buy 2, could you give me a better price?
goals: Confirm the price and currency.
Ask politely about a quantity discount.
Repeat the agreed total before paying.

title: Confirm an exchange quote
es: Si cambio 100 dólares, ¿cuántos pesos recibo después de la comisión?
en: If I exchange 100 dollars, how many pesos will I receive after the fee?
goals: State the starting amount and both currencies.
Ask which rate and fee apply.
Confirm the final amount received, not just the advertised rate.

title: Clarify a hotel card hold
es: ¿Es un cargo o una retención temporal? ¿Ya liberaron la retención de mi tarjeta?
en: Is this a charge or a temporary hold? Have you released the hold on my card yet?
goals: Separate the room payment from the security hold.
Ask about release status and confirmation.
Agree whom to contact if the amount remains unavailable.
